caption: The drawing depicts a blue cloak with a hood and a short capelet over the shoulders, rendered in a realistic style. The cloak is fastened at the neck with a blue tie that is knotted in front. The outer surface of the cloak is a muted, medium-toned blue, while the inner lining visible at the opening is a paler blue. The cloak drapes down in soft folds and appears to be made of a heavy fabric. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist’s signature, “E. GAUSSER,” is written in small, uppercase letters in the lower right area of the drawing. There are no other objects or elements present in the image.
title: Shaker Doll's Cloak
